objective: Generate better-qualified customer enquiries and home-service booking opportunities for local repair businesses
core_message: Repair businesses need better-qualified enquiries, not just more calls. Understand the problem, location and service timing to plan home-service visits better.

script.notes: One complete, user-approved six-scene Hinglish ad. One continuous ElevenLabs Viraj narration performs all characters. Do not split into multiple creative variants.

variants.hook: Bhai, enquiries toh bahut aa rahi hain... lekin confirmed home service bookings?
variants.script_text:
[frustrated] Bhai, enquiries toh bahut aa rahi hain... [pause] lekin confirmed home service bookings? [disappointed] Woh toh jaise gayab hi ho gayi hain!
[playful] Arre Lala Bhai! Phone toh garam ho raha hai... [teasing] par business thanda kyun pada hai?
[annoyed] Kya bataun, Bhai! Koi sirf price poochta hai, koi service area ke bahar hota hai... aur koi bolta hai, "Baad mein batata hoon."
[confident] Toh problem enquiries ki quantity nahi hai, Lala Bhai... [emphasis] problem hai unki quality!
[confused] Matlab?
[explaining] Matlab, har enquiry actual customer nahi hoti. Tumhe aise log chahiye jinhe sach mein repair service ki zaroorat ho.
[upbeat] Aur yahin FixReach karta hai help! [confident] Better-qualified customer enquiries aur home-service booking opportunities paane mein.
[clear, deliberate] Customer se samjho teen simple cheezein:
[slight pause] Pehli — problem kya hai?
[slight pause] Doosri — location kahan hai?
[slight pause] Teesri — service kab chahiye?
[reassuring] Isse tum customer ki requirement samajh sakte ho aur home service visit schedule karne mein better planning kar sakte ho.
[realization] Achhaaa! Matlab ab sirf phone calls ke peeche nahi bhaagna... [excited] balki actual service chahne wale customers par focus karna hai!
[affirming] Bilkul! Technician ko bhi pata hoga ki kis customer ke ghar jaana hai.
[energetic, direct] Aap bhi repair business chalate ho? Aur better leads chahte ho?
[excited] Toh comment karo "LEADS"!
[enthusiastic] FixReach ki taraf se milega aapko FREE Campaign Audit!
[cheerful] Bilkul free, Bhai! Apni campaigns ka haal jaan lo!

voice_profile.notes: One continuous user-supplied recording; one narrator performs every character. Keep scene headings and on-screen CTA out of spoken audio.
